name: Clicks
long_description: Clicks builds AI agents that automate back-office operations for RCM companies and healthcare providers. Our agents work across EHRs, payer portals, desktop applications, and legacy systems, following existing processes, handling exceptions, and escalating when human judgment is needed. Backed by Y Combinator, Clicks helps teams improve accuracy, shorten turnaround times, and reduce operating costs, with SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance built in.
one_liner: AI agents for your back-office operations.
